abilities.name: Jade Screen
abilities.description:
Ningguang creates a Jade Screen out of gold, obsidian, and her great opulence, dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Jade Screen
·Blocks opponents' projectiles.
·Endurance scales based on Ningguang's Max HP.

Jade Screen is considered a Geo Construct and can be used to block certain attacks, but cannot be climbed. Only one Jade Screen may exist at any one time.
_curatorNotes: Jade Screen construct spawns at frame 0 (Constructs.New called directly, not in a task queue). Damage hitmark is at skillHitmark=17. C2 (Shock Effect) resets skill CD when the screen is destroyed (6s ICD), including when destroyed by Starshatter (Q).

Burst (Starshatter) also destroys the active Jade Screen via c.Core.Constructs.Destroy(c.lastScreen) and fires additional gem projectiles. The terminatesOn field records only 'recast' (new E cast); reviewer to decide if 'onBurst' also warrants representation.

Application: gcsim internal/characters/ningguang/skill.go, func Skill — the single QueueAttackWithSnap is scheduled at skillHitmark=17 with ai.Element=attributes.Geo and ai.Durability=25 (=1U). Mult is skill[c.TalentLvlSkill()] from zz_ningguang.dm.go (skill[9]=4.1472), cross-checked against docs/curation/talents/ningguang.json row 'Skill DMG' 10th value 414.72%.

No tick series is authored for the Jade Screen summon and that is correct: the construct (screen.go) implements only construct.Construct — Key/Type/Expiry/Count/Direction/Pos plus an OnDestruct that resets skill CD at C2. It carries no AttackInfo and skill.go adds no QueueCharTask/Tasks.Add for a repeating hit, so the screen is a genuinely damage-free geometry shell.

abilities.description:
Gathering a great number of gems, Ningguang scatters them all at once, sending homing projectiles at her opponents that deal massive Geo DMG.
If Starshatter is cast when a Jade Screen is nearby, the Jade Screen will fire additional gem projectiles at the same time.

passives.name: Strategic Reserve
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. Likely onDash for the active character, firing only when a Ningguang Jade Screen construct is on-field (gcsim checks CountByType(GeoConstructNingSkill) > 0). Target: active character (not team — only the dashing character gets the buff). Duration 10s (600 frames). Stat: geoDmgBonus +12%. Source: asc.go subscribes to event.OnDash.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: Strategic Reserve — effects[0] (buff geoDmgBonus 12) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/ningguang/asc.go:17-38` — `a4` subscribes to `event.OnDash`, returns unless `Constructs.CountByType(GeoConstructNingSkill) > 0`, then adds a 600-frame `GeoP = 0.12` StatMod to `Core.Player.ActiveChar()`. that the real trigger is passing through the construct (gcsim models it as `OnDash` while a Ningguang screen stands) and that we have no such trigger — the Jade Screen's cast is the anchor, the 30s screen life is not the buff's length, and the 10s is the kit's own. It must also record that the target was WRONG: authored `self`, but both the kit ("a character") and gcsim (`ActiveChar()`) say the on-field character, so it is `active`. Drop the "Likely onDash… Reviewer to wire" line. ⚠️ ⚠️ TARGET CORRECTED — `self` → `active`, which promotes Ningguang from "no capability" to a buff family chip in the Team Builder. That is the right claim (she does buff whoever walks through) but it is a new chip, so say so. ⚠️ `target: 'active'` re-slices per on-field segment, so a character who picks the buff up and then swaps out keeps it in game and loses it here. ⚠️ Anchoring at the cast means a rotation that casts E and walks through it eight seconds later draws the bar eight seconds early; the caveat names that. ⛔ `onState` was considered and refused: `duringSummon` is inferred, never a `state` window, so nothing would match — and the one `onState` consumer drops `self`/non-team targets anyway.
passives.description: A character that passes through the Jade Screen will gain a 12% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s.
passives.caveat: The bar starts at the Jade Screen's cast; in game a character picks the bonus up by walking through the screen, any time in its 30s.
